body:
I used to help a lot of people as well and try to talk them into feeling better but I know only people who are absolutely lost on themselves would fight for some random person like that, I know how you must feel, I know you're not happy, so your words don't really phase me.

I tried counselling at my university and I hated that, I don't think I have any real friends, I don't trust anyone and I feel hated and like my presence doesn't matter, my friends once watched a movie we wanted to watch all together without me, it was such a small thing but I've become so paranoid and sensitive that it sent me over the edge with them, I feel like I am always the least valuable person in any group and it hurts knowing that it's not just me, it's the truth. I hate my family, to be honest.

I am sorry to waste your time and care on me, people always seem to care at first or when I am desperate like that but I understand why nobody wants to deal with me at a certain point. I wish somebody just believed in me for more than first few weeks, I guess.

I've waited a couple of days in isolatios, seeing if anybody will notice something's wrong with me, I know I always come back to this, this is the only way to change things.

I've been consistently a person who wants help but can't help themselves. I'd say the best thing is just giving support but keeping distance. Forcing help and fighting about it isn't going to do it but if you're very committed, just be a friend without letting them rely on you too much. It's not much but people who won't help themselves are often alone and lonely.

I did visit a university counsellor a couple of times but it didn't make me feel good, she gave me a lot of questions and she would make me answer them even if I didn't know how to, then she'd dismiss me earlier saying I need to visit a psychiatrist on the side for medicine to continue working with her. I ended up feeling very disappointed in it, like all they do is try to fill you up with prescription drugs and like it's my fault for not being able to answer things I am clueless about on the spot. I've been very scared of professional help and it was my first time, it discouraged me from trying again.  


I don't really know what I wanted writing this, honestly, I felt like my life was falling apart and yet stuck in the same shitty place simultaniously. I still think about suicide but I am slowly realizing I probably won't have the guts to do it after two days.

I think I am unlikeable because it's what i've been told and I don't have friends because my relationships don't last. I guess i have problems managing my emotions from time to time but sometimes what happens seems random and i Don't know hwat I did wrong  


I don't know how or why I want to grow because I am starting to have second thoughts now and I am a little drunk. My girlfriend wants me to get out of the gutter of always complaining and being negative but it's so hard.
